note: The negation 'Not' of 'Not right now' is held as a modifier instead of the negation of the fragment.
'Correct' is made the verb of an imperative clause that takes 'which airport', so 'which airport' is taken out of the question 'which airport and what time will my return flight arrive'.
The coordination of 'and' takes the fragment 'No' of the previous sentence as a third conjunct, though 'and' joins only 'There are four people' and 'I actually prefer American Airlines'.
